title: Glowing umbrella
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- canopy: bright arcs in warm colors -->
    <path d="M50 20 C30 20 15 32 12 48 L88 48 C85 32 70 20 50 20 Z" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
    <path d="M50 20 C42 20 34 24 28 31 L50 48 Z" fill="#ffb703"/>
    <path d="M50 20 C58 20 66 24 72 31 L50 48 Z" fill="#ffb703"/>
    <path d="M28 31 C22 37 18 43 16 48 L30 48 Z" fill="#ff9e00"/>
    <path d="M72 31 C78 37 82 43 84 48 L70 48 Z" fill="#ff9e00"/>
    <!-- glowing rim highlight -->
    <path d="M12 48 L88 48" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- scalloped edge -->
    <path d="M12 48 Q20 55 28 48 Q36 55 44 48 Q50 55 56 48 Q64 55 72 48 Q80 55 88 48" fill="none" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- pole -->
    <rect x="47.5" y="48" width="5" height="40" rx="2.5" fill="#7b2cbf"/>
    <!-- handle: glowing hook -->
    <path d="M50 88 Q50 95 42 95 Q34 95 34 88" fill="none" stroke="#9d4edd" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- top finial glow -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="3.5" fill="#ffe066"/>
    <!-- small sparkles -->
    <circle cx="24" cy="60" r="1.6" fill="#ffe066"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="62" r="1.6" fill="#ffe066"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="64" r="1.4" fill="#ffe066"/>
  </g>
</svg>
